subject: Urgent: Nashville shuttle bottleneck — badge droppoint & swing-shift cover
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: ops@nvl-events.com, dispatch@fleetshuttle.co
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-08T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Urgent: shuttle pileup at loading zone — badge handoff needed

Hi team,

We just hit a bottleneck at Loading Zone B — three vendor shuttles delayed (traffic / vehicle issues) and the Courtyard front desk is holding a stack of preprinted badges for AM arrivals. Attendees are starting to miss sessions. Can someone confirm:

- Which shuttle(s) can be rerouted to Entrance A (closer to registration desk)?
- Who from Fleet Shuttle dispatch can meet the front desk to pick up the badge packets?
- If we can’t move shuttles quickly, can the hotel do a temporary badge droppoint at Entrance A and one of our onsite temps take over handoffs?

I’ve attached the latest badge manifest (v2) and the shuttle dispatch view for reference. Want to avoid a queue at registration — we should use swing-shift staff if needed.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Field Events Lead | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1-615-555-0142

Attachments: badge_manifest_nashville_v2.csv, shuttle_dispatch_log_0908.pdf

Jordan —

Thanks for the heads up. We have two drivers with vehicle issues (ride IDs 2782, 2785) and one is being rerouted but will be late by ~35 minutes. I can dispatch van 2791 to Entrance A immediately — ETA 12 minutes. Driver Tony (cell: +1-615-555-0822) can grab the badge bundles if someone from the hotel confirms a handoff window.

Quick ask: can your team confirm which badge packets are priority (VIP / speakers) so we can prioritize delivery? We don’t want to mix boxes.

— Fleet Dispatch

— Marissa
